sampling: Balanced candidate/incumbent; round-robin across source_game_index within each agent; earliest ply ordering within each game, shuffled deterministically.

settings.root_search: Reused saved final selection_trace; no root MCTS rerun.
settings.opponent_response: Vanilla PUCT, same response budget for regression and progress.
settings.checkpoint_split: Candidate roots use candidate checkpoint; incumbent roots use incumbent checkpoint.

interpretation: One-ply opponent MCTS response plus unchanged neural value; diagnostic proxy, not minimax proof.
